title: Wiemer specs
description: A loud brand-orange spec sheet: a huge centred heading, a mono tab bar on a darker orange strip whose black active pill slides to the chosen part, a technical drawing frame with a thick dimension bar on top and one on the right, dotted extension lines and mm labels in mono, then a hairline and two columns: a note on the left, label/value spec rows with hairlines on the right.
notes: the band is the theme's primary colour with primary-foreground text
